hypothesis: Reduce readout seed variance using identical old features and fit rows; no new data or feature information is introduced.

members.architecture: Unchanged512->128 GELU/dropout.1->5 MLP; original ranked8 heads x64 and embedded original fit-only scaler.

data.fit_identity: Exact original head_probes.partitions densefit/sample_ix and sparse-long replacement; identical content and weights for every seed.
data.old_feature_bank: Reuse existing755282x512 F16 bank; no LM forward/extraction.
data.new96_status: Already used development/calibration set, not independent confirmation; never used to choose best epoch.
data.new96_features: Reuse existing augmentation bank validation subset only; none of the new256 fit documents enters training.

training.early_stop: Exact unchanged old5-profile mean-systemF1 helper, including its existing calibration semantics. Seed controls initialization, epoch order and dropout.
training.new96_gate: Freeze each best checkpoint/history/modelSHA before its first new96 evaluation.
training.workers: At most3 independent readout GPU workers, one per selected A40; no LM live; explicit terminate/reap on any failure.
training.technical_retry: Same seed/config only, with failure audit; never replace a poorly performing seed or extend the budget.

portable_drift_control.main_path: All4 models recomputed on both developer sets by the same CPU F32 portable path, same F16 features/scalers, eval mode/chunk4096; bind package/thread/matmul settings and row order.
portable_drift_control.original_saved_control: Keep original old173032 GPU p NPZ/fileSHA/sample_ix and original threshold unchanged; exactly reproduce the previously frozen metrics. Bind previously audited old-head new96 reference NPZ for its8-group fixed-threshold record.
portable_drift_control.full_drift_report: For oldCPU vs saved old173032 and oldCPU-new96 vs audited old-new96 reference: max/mean/quantiles absolute p delta, changed argmax counts and system-decision changes at original tau, per-group and total. CPU-at-original-tau metrics are a drift diagnostic, not an extra selectable record.
portable_drift_control.parity_gate: Every portable path requires same-vector CPU/GPU finite error<5e-4; full old/reference probability drift>=5e-4, invalid p or changed model/scaler/sample identity is a technical failure, never a tolerance to retune after outcomes.
portable_drift_control.attribution_guard: Promotion must beat/guard against both old-cpu-maximin and unchanged old-original. An apparent gain from CPU numerical drift alone is insufficient. Below-tolerance drift may still change threshold decisions and is reported.

ensemble.arithmetic: Fixed-order sum of the four common-CPU F32 p arrays in float64, divide4, cast final p to float32; no posthoc normalization, learned weights, temperature, member filtering or logit averaging.
ensemble.identity_guard: All4 member sample_ix/roles/head/scaler order equal; all member/mean rows finite, bounded and normalized; missing member means failure.

records.singleton_role: All3 new singleton-maximin records are diagnostic only, with complete8-group metrics. They cannot be promoted or used as fallback.
records.old-original: Saved old GPU developer p plus audited old-head new96 reference at exact original tau; unchanged legacy control.
records.old-cpu-maximin: Common CPU-recomputed old model calibrated by the same8-group maximin helper.

calibration.objective: Minimum24 actual-consumer systemP/R/BAcc values over8 groups.
calibration.tail_policy: Old/new tails contribute to min24 and are reported; no extra tail FPR feasibility, matching the preceding frozen objective.
calibration.grid: unique(linspace(.001,.999,199), quantile(all234472 saved F32 p_system,linspace(0,1,301)),1.000001), separately per maximin prediction array.
calibration.consumer: NumPy2 F32 p>=Python-float tau semantics; effectiveF32 grid with all24 P/R/BAcc direct-count checks per threshold, plus F1/FPR feasibility and global argmax.
calibration.undefined_precision: Infeasible; never replace by1 or0 to win calibration.
calibration.reuse: Production may reuse frozen augmentation metrics_at/maximin helper; future actual auditor must independently recompute.

promotion.strict_gain: Candidate min24 must exceed both controls by>1e-12.

guards_against_each_control.natural: Keep old-natural separate F1/accuracy floors and every truth-supported role recall; this legacy generated group has actual CoT support (old-head CoT recall .79572), so never label it SUA-only. Tool has no truth support and remains N/A. The later fresh public natural set is SUA-only; do not conflate these cohorts.

promotion.negative_result: If any guard fails, publish all6 records/reasons and stop; no singleton, alternate objective, reweighting, extra seed or test fallback. Current primary unchanged.

reporting_and_freeze.report_all_six_records: All8 groups separately; P/R/F1/BAcc/FPR, five-class accuracy/confusion/truth-supported macroF1/NLL, AUROC/AP/all-role recalls; pooled old+new descriptive only.
reporting_and_freeze.singleton_and_drift_evidence: All3 training histories/best and actual step counts; all4 common-CPU singleton predictions; original saved/CPU drift and decision changes. No selection by singleton outcome.
reporting_and_freeze.prospective_freeze: Root approval then immutable source/protocol/seeds/weights/data+sample/scaler/head/model/source dependency+package hashes before training or new candidate validation p. No formal declaration is performed by this draft.
reporting_and_freeze.goal: Keep absoluteP/R/BAcc>=.90 for long-full/tail/body positions and natural independent confirmation. Incremental developer promotion never completes or weakens that goal.

limitations: Identical fit rows/features across seeds are shared data, not independent datasets.
Existing20261021 was previously selected;4-member averaging is partly inherited, not an unbiased four-seed experiment.
Old5 and new96 are repeatedly reused developer data; ensemble threshold gains can overfit them.
Independent early stopping can change realized update totals; only per-epoch and maximum budgets are matched.
Averaging addresses optimization variance, not absent feature information; every negative is retained.

root_execution_decision.authorized_scope: Continue existing accuracy experiments; no additional human confirmation needed.
root_execution_decision.trial_results: All current long-data candidate records retained; promoted=False.
